#!/usr/bin/env python3
&quot;&quot;&quot;
Artifact consolidation system for FastPath evaluation pipeline.

Consolidates results from multiple JSONL files into unified datasets for analysis:
- Collects evaluation results across all variants (baseline, V1-V5, controls)
- Validates data consistency and completeness  
- Computes summary statistics and metadata
- Generates consolidated JSON output for downstream analysis
- Supports glob patterns for batch collection
&quot;&quot;&quot;

import argparse
import glob
import json
import logging
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Dict, List, Optional, Any, Set
from dataclasses import dataclass, asdict
import numpy as np
import hashlib
from collections import defaultdict, Counter

# Configure logging
logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO)
logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


@dataclass
class ConsolidatedResult:
    &quot;&quot;&quot;Single consolidated evaluation result.&quot;&quot;&quot;
    
    # Identifiers
    system: str
    budget: int
    seed: int
    repo_name: str
    question_id: str
    
    # Core metrics
    qa_score: float
    tokens_used: int
    latency_ms: float
    memory_mb: float
    
    # Quality indicators
    selection_hash: str
    timestamp: str
    
    # Optional extended metrics
    features: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None
    errors: Optional[List[str]] = None


@dataclass  
class CollectionSummary:
    &quot;&quot;&quot;Summary statistics for collected results.&quot;&quot;&quot;
    
    # Data overview
    total_results: int
    unique_systems: List[str]
    budgets: List[int] 
    seeds_per_system: Dict[str, int]
    
    # Quality metrics
    mean_qa_scores: Dict[str, float]
    token_utilization: Dict[str, float]
    latency_p95: Dict[str, float]
    
    # Validation results
    missing_pairs: List[Dict[str, Any]]
    duplicate_entries: List[Dict[str, Any]]
    data_quality_score: float
    
    # Metadata
    collection_timestamp: str
    source_files: List[str]


class ArtifactCollector:
    &quot;&quot;&quot;Consolidates evaluation artifacts from multiple sources.&quot;&quot;&quot;
    
    def __init__(self):
        self.results: List[ConsolidatedResult] = []
        self.errors: List[str] = []
        
    def collect_from_pattern(self, pattern: str) -&gt; None:
        &quot;&quot;&quot;Collect results from files matching glob pattern.&quot;&quot;&quot;
        files = glob.glob(pattern)
        
        if not files:
            logger.warning(f&quot;No files found matching pattern: {pattern}&quot;)
            return
            
        logger.info(f&quot;Collecting from {len(files)} files: {files}&quot;)
        
        for file_path in files:
            try:
                self.collect_from_file(Path(file_path))
            except Exception as e:
                error_msg = f&quot;Error processing {file_path}: {e}&quot;
                logger.error(error_msg)
                self.errors.append(error_msg)
                
    def collect_from_file(self, file_path: Path) -&gt; None:
        &quot;&quot;&quot;Collect results from a single JSONL file.&quot;&quot;&quot;
        if not file_path.exists():
            raise FileNotFoundError(f&quot;File not found: {file_path}&quot;)
            
        logger.info(f&quot;Processing file: {file_path}&quot;)
        
        count = 0
        with open(file_path, &#x27;r&#x27;) as f:
            for line_num, line in enumerate(f, 1):
                line = line.strip()
                if not line:
                    continue
                    
                try:
                    data = json.loads(line)
                    result = self._parse_result(data, file_path, line_num)
                    if result:
                        self.results.append(result)
                        count += 1
                except Exception as e:
                    error_msg = f&quot;Error parsing line {line_num} in {file_path}: {e}&quot;
                    logger.warning(error_msg)
                    self.errors.append(error_msg)
                    
        logger.info(f&quot;Collected {count} results from {file_path}&quot;)
        
    def _parse_result(self, data: Dict[str, Any], source_file: Path, line_num: int) -&gt; Optional[ConsolidatedResult]:
        &quot;&quot;&quot;Parse a single result record.&quot;&quot;&quot;
        try:
            # Validate required fields
            required_fields = [&#x27;system&#x27;, &#x27;budget&#x27;, &#x27;seed&#x27;, &#x27;qa_score&#x27;, &#x27;tokens_used&#x27;]
            missing_fields = [field for field in required_fields if field not in data]
            
            if missing_fields:
                raise ValueError(f&quot;Missing required fields: {missing_fields}&quot;)
                
            # Parse with defaults for optional fields
            return ConsolidatedResult(
                system=data[&#x27;system&#x27;],
                budget=int(data[&#x27;budget&#x27;]),
                seed=int(data[&#x27;seed&#x27;]),
                repo_name=data.get(&#x27;repo_name&#x27;, &#x27;unknown&#x27;),
                question_id=data.get(&#x27;question_id&#x27;, f&#x27;q_{data[&quot;seed&quot;]}&#x27;),
                qa_score=float(data[&#x27;qa_score&#x27;]),
                tokens_used=int(data[&#x27;tokens_used&#x27;]),
                latency_ms=float(data.get(&#x27;latency_ms&#x27;, 0.0)),
                memory_mb=float(data.get(&#x27;memory_mb&#x27;, 0.0)),
                selection_hash=data.get(&#x27;selection_hash&#x27;, &#x27;&#x27;),
                timestamp=data.get(&#x27;timestamp&#x27;, &#x27;&#x27;),
                features=data.get(&#x27;features&#x27;),
                errors=None
            )
            
        except Exception as e:
            logger.warning(f&quot;Failed to parse result from {source_file}:{line_num}: {e}&quot;)
            return None
            
    def validate_collection(self) -&gt; CollectionSummary:
        &quot;&quot;&quot;Validate collected data and generate summary.&quot;&quot;&quot;
        if not self.results:
            logger.warning(&quot;No results collected&quot;)
            return self._empty_summary()
            
        logger.info(f&quot;Validating {len(self.results)} collected results&quot;)
        
        # Basic statistics
        systems = list(set(r.system for r in self.results))
        budgets = sorted(list(set(r.budget for r in self.results)))
        
        # Count seeds per system
        seeds_per_system = {}
        for system in systems:
            system_results = [r for r in self.results if r.system == system]
            unique_seeds = set((r.budget, r.seed) for r in system_results)
            seeds_per_system[system] = len(unique_seeds)
            
        # Quality metrics
        mean_qa_scores = {}
        token_utilization = {}
        latency_p95 = {}
        
        for system in systems:
            system_results = [r for r in self.results if r.system == system]
            
            qa_scores = [r.qa_score for r in system_results]
            tokens = [r.tokens_used for r in system_results]
            latencies = [r.latency_ms for r in system_results]
            
            mean_qa_scores[system] = np.mean(qa_scores)
            token_utilization[system] = np.mean(tokens)
            latency_p95[system] = np.percentile(latencies, 95) if latencies else 0.0
            
        # Validate paired structure
        missing_pairs = self._find_missing_pairs()
        duplicate_entries = self._find_duplicates()
        
        # Data quality score
        quality_score = self._compute_quality_score(missing_pairs, duplicate_entries)
        
        return CollectionSummary(
            total_results=len(self.results),
            unique_systems=systems,
            budgets=budgets,
            seeds_per_system=seeds_per_system,
            mean_qa_scores=mean_qa_scores,
            token_utilization=token_utilization,
            latency_p95=latency_p95,
            missing_pairs=missing_pairs,
            duplicate_entries=duplicate_entries,
            data_quality_score=quality_score,
            collection_timestamp=str(Path.cwd().stat().st_mtime),
            source_files=list(set(str(f) for f in glob.glob(&quot;*.jsonl&quot;)))
        )
        
    def _find_missing_pairs(self) -&gt; List[Dict[str, Any]]:
        &quot;&quot;&quot;Find missing pairs in evaluation data.&quot;&quot;&quot;
        missing = []
        
        # Group by (budget, seed) to find missing systems
        pairs = defaultdict(set)
        for result in self.results:
            key = (result.budget, result.seed)
            pairs[key].add(result.system)
            
        # Find expected systems (baseline + variants)
        all_systems = set(r.system for r in self.results)
        
        for (budget, seed), systems in pairs.items():
            missing_systems = all_systems - systems
            if missing_systems:
                missing.append({
                    &#x27;budget&#x27;: budget,
                    &#x27;seed&#x27;: seed,
                    &#x27;missing_systems&#x27;: list(missing_systems)
                })
                
        return missing
        
    def _find_duplicates(self) -&gt; List[Dict[str, Any]]:
        &quot;&quot;&quot;Find duplicate entries.&quot;&quot;&quot;
        duplicates = []
        seen = set()
        
        for result in self.results:
            key = (result.system, result.budget, result.seed, result.repo_name, result.question_id)
            if key in seen:
                duplicates.append({
                    &#x27;system&#x27;: result.system,
                    &#x27;budget&#x27;: result.budget,
                    &#x27;seed&#x27;: result.seed,
                    &#x27;repo_name&#x27;: result.repo_name,
                    &#x27;question_id&#x27;: result.question_id
                })
            else:
                seen.add(key)
                
        return duplicates
        
    def _compute_quality_score(self, missing_pairs: List, duplicates: List) -&gt; float:
        &quot;&quot;&quot;Compute overall data quality score (0-100).&quot;&quot;&quot;
        if not self.results:
            return 0.0
            
        # Penalize missing pairs and duplicates
        completeness = max(0, 100 - len(missing_pairs) * 5)  # -5 points per missing pair
        uniqueness = max(0, 100 - len(duplicates) * 10)      # -10 points per duplicate
        
        # Check for reasonable QA scores (should be between 0 and 1)
        qa_scores = [r.qa_score for r in self.results]
        valid_qa_scores = sum(1 for score in qa_scores if 0 &lt;= score &lt;= 1)
        qa_validity = (valid_qa_scores / len(qa_scores)) * 100
        
        # Overall quality score (weighted average)
        quality_score = (completeness * 0.4 + uniqueness * 0.3 + qa_validity * 0.3)
        return round(quality_score, 1)
        
    def _empty_summary(self) -&gt; CollectionSummary:
        &quot;&quot;&quot;Return empty summary for case with no results.&quot;&quot;&quot;
        return CollectionSummary(
            total_results=0,
            unique_systems=[],
            budgets=[],
            seeds_per_system={},
            mean_qa_scores={},
            token_utilization={},
            latency_p95={},
            missing_pairs=[],
            duplicate_entries=[],
            data_quality_score=0.0,
            collection_timestamp=&quot;&quot;,
            source_files=[]
        )
        
    def save_consolidated_results(self, output_file: Path) -&gt; None:
        &quot;&quot;&quot;Save consolidated results with summary.&quot;&quot;&quot;
        
        # Generate summary
        summary = self.validate_collection()
        
        # Prepare output data
        output_data = {
            &#x27;summary&#x27;: asdict(summary),
            &#x27;collection_errors&#x27;: self.errors,
            &#x27;results&#x27;: [asdict(result) for result in self.results]
        }
        
        # Save to file
        output_file.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        
        with open(output_file, &#x27;w&#x27;) as f:
            json.dump(output_data, f, indent=2)
            
        logger.info(f&quot;Saved {len(self.results)} consolidated results to {output_file}&quot;)
        logger.info(f&quot;Data quality score: {summary.data_quality_score}/100&quot;)
        
        # Print validation warnings
        if summary.missing_pairs:
            logger.warning(f&quot;Found {len(summary.missing_pairs)} incomplete evaluation pairs&quot;)
            
        if summary.duplicate_entries:
            logger.warning(f&quot;Found {len(summary.duplicate_entries)} duplicate entries&quot;)
            
        if self.errors:
            logger.warning(f&quot;Encountered {len(self.errors)} collection errors&quot;)


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description=&quot;Consolidate FastPath evaluation artifacts&quot;,
        formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter,
        epilog=&quot;&quot;&quot;
Examples:
  # Collect all JSONL files in artifacts directory
  python collect.py --glob &quot;artifacts/*.jsonl&quot; --out artifacts/collected.json
  
  # Collect specific files
  python collect.py --files artifacts/baseline.jsonl artifacts/v5.jsonl --out artifacts/collected.json
        &quot;&quot;&quot;
    )
    
    parser.add_argument(&#x27;--glob&#x27;, type=str,
                        help=&#x27;Glob pattern for input files (e.g., &quot;artifacts/*.jsonl&quot;)&#x27;)
    parser.add_argument(&#x27;--files&#x27;, nargs=&#x27;+&#x27;,
                        help=&#x27;Specific input files&#x27;)
    parser.add_argument(&#x27;--out&#x27;, type=str, required=True,
                        help=&#x27;Output consolidated JSON file&#x27;)
    parser.add_argument(&#x27;--validate-only&#x27;, action=&#x27;store_true&#x27;,
                        help=&#x27;Only validate data, do not save results&#x27;)
    
    args = parser.parse_args()
    
    if not args.glob and not args.files:

    # Create collector
    collector = ArtifactCollector()
    
    # Collect from specified sources
    if args.glob:
        collector.collect_from_pattern(args.glob)
        
    if args.files:

            collector.collect_from_file(Path(file_path))
            
    if not collector.results and not args.validate_only:

    # Generate summary

    print(f&quot;\nCollection Summary:&quot;)

    print(f&quot;Systems: {&#x27;, &#x27;.join(summary.unique_systems)}&quot;)
    print(f&quot;Budgets: {summary.budgets}&quot;)
    print(f&quot;Data quality score: {summary.data_quality_score}/100&quot;)
    
    if summary.missing_pairs:
        print(f&quot;Warning: {len(summary.missing_pairs)} missing evaluation pairs&quot;)
        
    if summary.duplicate_entries:
        print(f&quot;Warning: {len(summary.duplicate_entries)} duplicate entries&quot;)
        
    if collector.errors:
        print(f&quot;Warning: {len(collector.errors)} collection errors&quot;)
        
    # Save results unless validate-only mode
    if not args.validate_only:

    # Exit with non-zero code if quality issues

#!/usr/bin/env python3
&quot;&quot;&quot;
BCa Bootstrap Implementation with FDR Control for FastPath Evaluation.

Implements paired difference analysis with:
- Bias-Corrected and Accelerated (BCa) bootstrap confidence intervals
- False Discovery Rate (FDR) control using Benjamini-Hochberg procedure
- Paired evaluation support for baseline vs. variant comparisons
- Conservative statistical validation for promotion decisions

Reference:
- Efron &amp; Tibshirani (1993), &quot;An Introduction to the Bootstrap&quot;
- Benjamini &amp; Hochberg (1995), &quot;Controlling the false discovery rate&quot;
&quot;&quot;&quot;

import argparse
import json
import logging
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Dict, List, Optional, Tuple, Any
from dataclasses import dataclass, asdict
import numpy as np
from scipy import stats
import warnings

# Configure logging
logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO)
logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

# Suppress numerical warnings
warnings.filterwarnings(&quot;ignore&quot;, category=RuntimeWarning)


@dataclass
class PairedBootstrapResult:
    &quot;&quot;&quot;Results from paired BCa bootstrap analysis.&quot;&quot;&quot;
    
    # Comparison metadata
    baseline_system: str
    experimental_system: str
    metric_name: str
    budget: int
    
    # Sample statistics
    n_pairs: int
    observed_difference: float
    observed_difference_pct: float
    baseline_mean: float
    experimental_mean: float
    
    # Bootstrap results
    n_bootstrap: int
    bootstrap_mean: float
    bootstrap_std: float
    
    # BCa confidence interval
    ci_lower: float
    ci_upper: float
    confidence_level: float
    
    # Statistical significance
    p_value: float
    significant_raw: bool
    significant_fdr: bool
    fdr_adjusted_alpha: float
    
    # Quality metrics
    effective_sample_size: int
    bootstrap_convergence: bool
    bias_correction: float
    acceleration: float


class PairedBootstrapAnalyzer:
    &quot;&quot;&quot;Paired bootstrap analysis with BCa confidence intervals and FDR control.&quot;&quot;&quot;
    
    def __init__(self, n_bootstrap: int = 10000, confidence_level: float = 0.95):
        self.n_bootstrap = n_bootstrap
        self.confidence_level = confidence_level
        self.alpha = 1 - confidence_level
        
    def load_results(self, baseline_file: Path, experimental_file: Path) -&gt; Tuple[List[Dict], List[Dict]]:
        &quot;&quot;&quot;Load paired evaluation results from JSONL files.&quot;&quot;&quot;
        baseline_results = []
        experimental_results = []
        
        # Load baseline results
        with open(baseline_file, &#x27;r&#x27;) as f:
            for line in f:
                baseline_results.append(json.loads(line.strip()))
                
        # Load experimental results  
        with open(experimental_file, &#x27;r&#x27;) as f:
            for line in f:
                experimental_results.append(json.loads(line.strip()))
                
        logger.info(f&quot;Loaded {len(baseline_results)} baseline and {len(experimental_results)} experimental results&quot;)
        
        return baseline_results, experimental_results
        
    def create_paired_samples(
        self, 
        baseline_results: List[Dict], 
        experimental_results: List[Dict],
        metric: str = &quot;qa_score&quot;
    ) -&gt; Dict[Tuple[int, int], Tuple[float, float]]:
        &quot;&quot;&quot;Create paired samples matching by budget and seed.&quot;&quot;&quot;
        
        # Index baseline results
        baseline_index = {}
        for result in baseline_results:
            key = (result[&#x27;budget&#x27;], result[&#x27;seed&#x27;])
            baseline_index[key] = result[metric]
            
        # Create pairs
        paired_samples = {}
        for result in experimental_results:
            key = (result[&#x27;budget&#x27;], result[&#x27;seed&#x27;])
            if key in baseline_index:
                paired_samples[key] = (baseline_index[key], result[metric])
                
        logger.info(f&quot;Created {len(paired_samples)} paired samples&quot;)
        return paired_samples
        
    def compute_bca_bootstrap(
        self,
        baseline_values: np.ndarray,
        experimental_values: np.ndarray,
        metric_name: str,
        budget: int
    ) -&gt; PairedBootstrapResult:
        &quot;&quot;&quot;Compute BCa bootstrap confidence interval for paired differences.&quot;&quot;&quot;
        
        n_pairs = len(baseline_values)
        if n_pairs &lt; 10:
            raise ValueError(f&quot;Insufficient paired samples: {n_pairs} &lt; 10&quot;)
            
        # Compute observed difference
        differences = experimental_values - baseline_values
        observed_diff = np.mean(differences)
        observed_diff_pct = (observed_diff / np.mean(baseline_values)) * 100
        
        logger.info(f&quot;Observed difference: {observed_diff:.4f} ({observed_diff_pct:+.2f}%)&quot;)
        
        # Bootstrap resampling
        bootstrap_diffs = []
        rng = np.random.RandomState(42)  # Reproducible results
        
        for i in range(self.n_bootstrap):
            # Sample with replacement
            indices = rng.choice(n_pairs, size=n_pairs, replace=True)
            bootstrap_baseline = baseline_values[indices]
            bootstrap_experimental = experimental_values[indices]
            bootstrap_diff = np.mean(bootstrap_experimental - bootstrap_baseline)
            bootstrap_diffs.append(bootstrap_diff)
            
        bootstrap_diffs = np.array(bootstrap_diffs)
        
        # Bias correction
        n_less = np.sum(bootstrap_diffs &lt; observed_diff)
        bias_correction = stats.norm.ppf(n_less / self.n_bootstrap) if n_less &gt; 0 else 0.0
        
        # Acceleration constant via jackknife
        acceleration = self._compute_acceleration(baseline_values, experimental_values)
        
        # BCa confidence interval
        z_alpha_2 = stats.norm.ppf(self.alpha / 2)
        z_1_alpha_2 = stats.norm.ppf(1 - self.alpha / 2)
        
        alpha_1 = stats.norm.cdf(bias_correction + (bias_correction + z_alpha_2) / 
                                (1 - acceleration * (bias_correction + z_alpha_2)))
        alpha_2 = stats.norm.cdf(bias_correction + (bias_correction + z_1_alpha_2) / 
                                (1 - acceleration * (bias_correction + z_1_alpha_2)))
        
        # Handle edge cases
        alpha_1 = np.clip(alpha_1, 0.001, 0.999)
        alpha_2 = np.clip(alpha_2, 0.001, 0.999)
        
        ci_lower = np.percentile(bootstrap_diffs, alpha_1 * 100)
        ci_upper = np.percentile(bootstrap_diffs, alpha_2 * 100)
        
        # P-value (two-tailed test)
        p_value = 2 * min(
            np.mean(bootstrap_diffs &lt;= 0),
            np.mean(bootstrap_diffs &gt;= 0)
        )
        
        # Convergence check
        convergence = self._check_convergence(bootstrap_diffs)
        
        return PairedBootstrapResult(
            baseline_system=&quot;baseline&quot;,
            experimental_system=&quot;experimental&quot;, 
            metric_name=metric_name,
            budget=budget,
            n_pairs=n_pairs,
            observed_difference=observed_diff,
            observed_difference_pct=observed_diff_pct,
            baseline_mean=np.mean(baseline_values),
            experimental_mean=np.mean(experimental_values),
            n_bootstrap=self.n_bootstrap,
            bootstrap_mean=np.mean(bootstrap_diffs),
            bootstrap_std=np.std(bootstrap_diffs),
            ci_lower=ci_lower,
            ci_upper=ci_upper,
            confidence_level=self.confidence_level,
            p_value=p_value,
            significant_raw=p_value &lt; self.alpha,
            significant_fdr=False,  # Set by FDR procedure
            fdr_adjusted_alpha=self.alpha,  # Set by FDR procedure
            effective_sample_size=n_pairs,
            bootstrap_convergence=convergence,
            bias_correction=bias_correction,
            acceleration=acceleration
        )
        
    def _compute_acceleration(self, baseline_values: np.ndarray, experimental_values: np.ndarray) -&gt; float:
        &quot;&quot;&quot;Compute acceleration constant via jackknife.&quot;&quot;&quot;
        n = len(baseline_values)
        differences = experimental_values - baseline_values
        
        # Jackknife estimates
        jackknife_means = []
        for i in range(n):
            # Leave-one-out
            jackknife_diffs = np.concatenate([differences[:i], differences[i+1:]])
            jackknife_means.append(np.mean(jackknife_diffs))
            
        jackknife_means = np.array(jackknife_means)
        overall_mean = np.mean(jackknife_means)
        
        # Acceleration constant
        numerator = np.sum((overall_mean - jackknife_means) ** 3)
        denominator = 6 * (np.sum((overall_mean - jackknife_means) ** 2) ** 1.5)
        
        if denominator == 0:
            return 0.0
            
        acceleration = numerator / denominator
        return acceleration
        
    def _check_convergence(self, bootstrap_samples: np.ndarray) -&gt; bool:
        &quot;&quot;&quot;Check bootstrap convergence using running mean stability.&quot;&quot;&quot;
        n_samples = len(bootstrap_samples)
        if n_samples &lt; 1000:
            return False
            
        # Check if running mean stabilizes
        running_means = np.cumsum(bootstrap_samples) / np.arange(1, n_samples + 1)
        
        # Compare last 10% vs previous 10%
        n_check = n_samples // 10
        last_segment = running_means[-n_check:]
        prev_segment = running_means[-2*n_check:-n_check]
        
        relative_change = np.abs(np.mean(last_segment) - np.mean(prev_segment)) / np.abs(np.mean(prev_segment))
        
        return relative_change &lt; 0.01  # 1% relative change threshold
        
    def apply_fdr_control(self, results: List[PairedBootstrapResult], fdr_level: float = 0.05) -&gt; List[PairedBootstrapResult]:
        &quot;&quot;&quot;Apply Benjamini-Hochberg FDR control to multiple comparisons.&quot;&quot;&quot;
        if not results:
            return results
            
        # Sort by p-value
        sorted_results = sorted(results, key=lambda x: x.p_value)
        n_tests = len(sorted_results)
        
        # Apply Benjamini-Hochberg procedure
        for i, result in enumerate(sorted_results):
            bh_threshold = fdr_level * (i + 1) / n_tests
            result.fdr_adjusted_alpha = bh_threshold
            result.significant_fdr = result.p_value &lt;= bh_threshold
            
        logger.info(f&quot;FDR control: {sum(r.significant_fdr for r in results)}/{n_tests} tests significant at FDR={fdr_level}&quot;)
        
        return results
        
    def analyze_paired_results(
        self, 
        baseline_file: Path, 
        experimental_file: Path,
        metric: str = &quot;qa_score&quot;,
        fdr_level: float = 0.05
    ) -&gt; List[PairedBootstrapResult]:
        &quot;&quot;&quot;Complete paired bootstrap analysis with FDR control.&quot;&quot;&quot;
        
        # Load data
        baseline_results, experimental_results = self.load_results(baseline_file, experimental_file)
        
        # Create paired samples
        paired_samples = self.create_paired_samples(baseline_results, experimental_results, metric)
        
        # Group by budget
        budget_groups = {}
        for (budget, seed), (baseline_val, exp_val) in paired_samples.items():
            if budget not in budget_groups:
                budget_groups[budget] = {&#x27;baseline&#x27;: [], &#x27;experimental&#x27;: []}
            budget_groups[budget][&#x27;baseline&#x27;].append(baseline_val)
            budget_groups[budget][&#x27;experimental&#x27;].append(exp_val)
            
        # Analyze each budget separately
        bootstrap_results = []
        for budget in sorted(budget_groups.keys()):
            baseline_vals = np.array(budget_groups[budget][&#x27;baseline&#x27;])
            experimental_vals = np.array(budget_groups[budget][&#x27;experimental&#x27;])
            
            logger.info(f&quot;Analyzing budget {budget} with {len(baseline_vals)} pairs&quot;)
            
            result = self.compute_bca_bootstrap(
                baseline_vals, experimental_vals, metric, budget
            )
            bootstrap_results.append(result)
            
        # Apply FDR control across all budgets
        bootstrap_results = self.apply_fdr_control(bootstrap_results, fdr_level)
        
        return bootstrap_results


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description=&quot;Paired BCa bootstrap analysis with FDR control&quot;,
        formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter,
        epilog=&quot;&quot;&quot;
Example:
  python paired_bootstrap.py --baseline artifacts/baseline.jsonl --exp artifacts/v5.jsonl --bca --iters 10000 --fdr --out artifacts/ci.json
        &quot;&quot;&quot;
    )
    
    parser.add_argument(&#x27;--baseline&#x27;, type=str, required=True,
                        help=&#x27;Baseline results JSONL file&#x27;)
    parser.add_argument(&#x27;--exp&#x27;, type=str, required=True,
                        help=&#x27;Experimental results JSONL file&#x27;)
    parser.add_argument(&#x27;--metric&#x27;, type=str, default=&#x27;qa_score&#x27;,
                        help=&#x27;Metric to analyze&#x27;)
    parser.add_argument(&#x27;--bca&#x27;, action=&#x27;store_true&#x27;,
                        help=&#x27;Use BCa bootstrap (vs standard percentile)&#x27;)
    parser.add_argument(&#x27;--iters&#x27;, type=int, default=10000,
                        help=&#x27;Number of bootstrap iterations&#x27;)
    parser.add_argument(&#x27;--fdr&#x27;, action=&#x27;store_true&#x27;,
                        help=&#x27;Apply FDR control for multiple comparisons&#x27;)
    parser.add_argument(&#x27;--fdr-level&#x27;, type=float, default=0.05,
                        help=&#x27;FDR control level&#x27;)
    parser.add_argument(&#x27;--confidence&#x27;, type=float, default=0.95,
                        help=&#x27;Confidence level&#x27;)
    parser.add_argument(&#x27;--out&#x27;, type=str, required=True,
                        help=&#x27;Output JSON file&#x27;)
    
    args = parser.parse_args()
    
    # Create analyzer
    analyzer = PairedBootstrapAnalyzer(
        n_bootstrap=args.iters,
        confidence_level=args.confidence
    )
    
    # Run analysis
    results = analyzer.analyze_paired_results(
        baseline_file=Path(args.baseline),
        experimental_file=Path(args.exp),
        metric=args.metric,
        fdr_level=args.fdr_level if args.fdr else None
    )
    
    # Save results
    output_path = Path(args.out)
    output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    
    with open(output_path, &#x27;w&#x27;) as f:
        json.dump({
            &#x27;analysis_type&#x27;: &#x27;paired_bca_bootstrap&#x27;,
            &#x27;parameters&#x27;: {
                &#x27;n_bootstrap&#x27;: args.iters,
                &#x27;confidence_level&#x27;: args.confidence,
                &#x27;fdr_control&#x27;: args.fdr,
                &#x27;fdr_level&#x27;: args.fdr_level if args.fdr else None,
                &#x27;metric&#x27;: args.metric
            },
            &#x27;results&#x27;: [asdict(result) for result in results]
        }, f, indent=2)
        
    logger.info(f&quot;Saved analysis results to {output_path}&quot;)
    
    # Print summary
    print(f&quot;\nPaired Bootstrap Analysis Summary:&quot;)
    print(f&quot;Metric: {args.metric}&quot;)
    print(f&quot;Confidence Level: {args.confidence}&quot;)
    print(f&quot;Bootstrap Iterations: {args.iters}&quot;)
    if args.fdr:
        print(f&quot;FDR Control Level: {args.fdr_level}&quot;)
    print()
    
    for result in results:

#!/usr/bin/env python3
&quot;&quot;&quot;
Statistical analysis framework for FastPath evaluation results.

Provides comprehensive analysis of evaluation data:
- QA performance scoring and token efficiency analysis
- Statistical significance testing with multiple comparison correction
- Category-specific performance breakdown (Usage, Config, Dependencies, etc.)
- Promotion decision support based on acceptance gates
- Effect size computation and practical significance assessment
&quot;&quot;&quot;

import argparse
import json
import logging
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Dict, List, Optional, Tuple, Any
from dataclasses import dataclass, asdict
import numpy as np
from scipy import stats
import warnings

# Configure logging  
logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO)
logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

# Suppress numerical warnings
warnings.filterwarnings(&quot;ignore&quot;, category=RuntimeWarning)


@dataclass
class CategoryMetrics:
    &quot;&quot;&quot;Metrics for a specific evaluation category.&quot;&quot;&quot;
    category: str
    n_samples: int
    mean_score: float
    std_score: float
    median_score: float
    p25_score: float
    p75_score: float
    
    # Token efficiency
    mean_tokens: float
    qa_per_100k_tokens: float
    
    # Improvement metrics (vs baseline)
    improvement_pct: Optional[float] = None
    improvement_ci_lower: Optional[float] = None
    improvement_ci_upper: Optional[float] = None
    effect_size: Optional[float] = None
    p_value: Optional[float] = None
    significant: Optional[bool] = None


@dataclass  
class SystemAnalysis:
    &quot;&quot;&quot;Complete analysis for one system variant.&quot;&quot;&quot;
    system: str
    
    # Overall performance
    overall_qa_score: float
    overall_qa_per_100k: float
    overall_improvement_pct: float
    overall_effect_size: float
    overall_p_value: float
    
    # Budget-specific results
    budget_results: Dict[int, CategoryMetrics]
    
    # Category breakdown
    category_results: Dict[str, CategoryMetrics]
    
    # Quality indicators
    meets_target_improvement: bool
    meets_significance_threshold: bool
    data_completeness: float
    
    # Metadata
    n_total_evaluations: int
    unique_repos: int
    unique_seeds: int


@dataclass
class PromotionDecision:
    &quot;&quot;&quot;Promotion decision with supporting evidence.&quot;&quot;&quot;
    decision: str  # PROMOTE, REJECT, DEFER
    confidence: float  # 0-100
    
    # Gate results
    quality_gate_pass: bool
    significance_gate_pass: bool
    improvement_gate_pass: bool
    
    # Supporting metrics
    min_improvement_achieved: float
    ci_lower_bound: float
    effect_size: float
    
    # Reasons
    promotion_blockers: List[str]
    promotion_supporters: List[str]
    
    # Recommendations
    next_actions: List[str]


class StatisticalAnalyzer:
    &quot;&quot;&quot;Comprehensive statistical analysis of FastPath evaluation results.&quot;&quot;&quot;
    
    def __init__(self):
        self.target_improvement = 13.0  # ≥ +13% QA/100k per TODO.md
        self.significance_threshold = 0.05
        self.minimum_effect_size = 0.3  # Cohen&#x27;s d
        
    def load_consolidated_results(self, results_file: Path) -&gt; Dict[str, Any]:
        &quot;&quot;&quot;Load consolidated evaluation results.&quot;&quot;&quot;
        with open(results_file, &#x27;r&#x27;) as f:
            data = json.load(f)
            
        logger.info(f&quot;Loaded {len(data[&#x27;results&#x27;])} consolidated results&quot;)
        return data
        
    def analyze_system(self, results: List[Dict], system: str) -&gt; SystemAnalysis:
        &quot;&quot;&quot;Analyze results for a specific system.&quot;&quot;&quot;
        system_results = [r for r in results if r[&#x27;system&#x27;] == system]
        
        if not system_results:
            raise ValueError(f&quot;No results found for system: {system}&quot;)
            
        logger.info(f&quot;Analyzing {len(system_results)} results for system: {system}&quot;)
        
        # Overall metrics
        qa_scores = [r[&#x27;qa_score&#x27;] for r in system_results]
        tokens_used = [r[&#x27;tokens_used&#x27;] for r in system_results]
        
        overall_qa_score = np.mean(qa_scores)
        overall_qa_per_100k = (np.sum(qa_scores) / np.sum(tokens_used)) * 100000
        
        # Budget-specific analysis
        budget_results = {}
        budgets = sorted(set(r[&#x27;budget&#x27;] for r in system_results))
        
        for budget in budgets:
            budget_data = [r for r in system_results if r[&#x27;budget&#x27;] == budget]
            budget_results[budget] = self._analyze_budget_group(budget_data, &#x27;overall&#x27;, budget)
            
        # Category analysis (placeholder - would need category labels in data)
        category_results = {
            &#x27;usage&#x27;: self._analyze_category_group(system_results, &#x27;usage&#x27;),
            &#x27;config&#x27;: self._analyze_category_group(system_results, &#x27;config&#x27;),
            &#x27;dependencies&#x27;: self._analyze_category_group(system_results, &#x27;dependencies&#x27;),
            &#x27;implementation&#x27;: self._analyze_category_group(system_results, &#x27;implementation&#x27;)
        }
        
        # Quality indicators
        n_total = len(system_results)
        unique_repos = len(set(r[&#x27;repo_name&#x27;] for r in system_results))
        unique_seeds = len(set(r[&#x27;seed&#x27;] for r in system_results))
        
        data_completeness = min(100.0, (n_total / (len(budgets) * 100)) * 100)  # Expect 100 seeds per budget
        
        return SystemAnalysis(
            system=system,
            overall_qa_score=overall_qa_score,
            overall_qa_per_100k=overall_qa_per_100k,
            overall_improvement_pct=0.0,  # Set by comparative analysis
            overall_effect_size=0.0,     # Set by comparative analysis
            overall_p_value=1.0,         # Set by comparative analysis
            budget_results=budget_results,
            category_results=category_results,
            meets_target_improvement=False,  # Set by comparative analysis
            meets_significance_threshold=False,  # Set by comparative analysis
            data_completeness=data_completeness,
            n_total_evaluations=n_total,
            unique_repos=unique_repos,
            unique_seeds=unique_seeds
        )
        
    def _analyze_budget_group(self, results: List[Dict], category: str, budget: int) -&gt; CategoryMetrics:
        &quot;&quot;&quot;Analyze a group of results for specific budget/category.&quot;&quot;&quot;
        qa_scores = [r[&#x27;qa_score&#x27;] for r in results]
        tokens = [r[&#x27;tokens_used&#x27;] for r in results]
        
        return CategoryMetrics(
            category=f&quot;{category}_budget_{budget}&quot;,
            n_samples=len(results),
            mean_score=np.mean(qa_scores),
            std_score=np.std(qa_scores),
            median_score=np.median(qa_scores),
            p25_score=np.percentile(qa_scores, 25),
            p75_score=np.percentile(qa_scores, 75),
            mean_tokens=np.mean(tokens),
            qa_per_100k_tokens=(np.sum(qa_scores) / np.sum(tokens)) * 100000
        )
        
    def _analyze_category_group(self, results: List[Dict], category: str) -&gt; CategoryMetrics:
        &quot;&quot;&quot;Analyze results for a specific category (placeholder implementation).&quot;&quot;&quot;
        # In a real implementation, this would filter results by category
        # For now, return overall metrics with category label
        qa_scores = [r[&#x27;qa_score&#x27;] for r in results]
        tokens = [r[&#x27;tokens_used&#x27;] for r in results]
        
        return CategoryMetrics(
            category=category,
            n_samples=len(results),
            mean_score=np.mean(qa_scores),
            std_score=np.std(qa_scores),

            p25_score=np.percentile(qa_scores, 25),
            p75_score=np.percentile(qa_scores, 75),
            mean_tokens=np.mean(tokens),
            qa_per_100k_tokens=(np.sum(qa_scores) / np.sum(tokens)) * 100000
        )
        
    def compare_systems(
        self, 
        baseline_analysis: SystemAnalysis,
        experimental_analysis: SystemAnalysis
    ) -&gt; SystemAnalysis:
        &quot;&quot;&quot;Compare experimental system against baseline.&quot;&quot;&quot;
        
        # Calculate improvements
        baseline_qa_per_100k = baseline_analysis.overall_qa_per_100k
        exp_qa_per_100k = experimental_analysis.overall_qa_per_100k
        
        improvement_pct = ((exp_qa_per_100k - baseline_qa_per_100k) / baseline_qa_per_100k) * 100
        
        # Effect size (Cohen&#x27;s d)
        pooled_std = np.sqrt((baseline_analysis.overall_qa_score**2 + experimental_analysis.overall_qa_score**2) / 2)
        if pooled_std &gt; 0:
            effect_size = (experimental_analysis.overall_qa_score - baseline_analysis.overall_qa_score) / pooled_std
        else:
            effect_size = 0.0
            
        # Update experimental analysis with comparative metrics
        experimental_analysis.overall_improvement_pct = improvement_pct
        experimental_analysis.overall_effect_size = effect_size
        experimental_analysis.meets_target_improvement = improvement_pct &gt;= self.target_improvement
        
        logger.info(f&quot;System {experimental_analysis.system}:&quot;)
        logger.info(f&quot;  Improvement: {improvement_pct:+.2f}% QA/100k tokens&quot;)
        logger.info(f&quot;  Effect size: {effect_size:.3f}&quot;)
        logger.info(f&quot;  Meets target: {&#x27;Yes&#x27; if improvement_pct &gt;= self.target_improvement else &#x27;No&#x27;}&quot;)
        
        return experimental_analysis
        
    def make_promotion_decision(
        self,
        system_analysis: SystemAnalysis,
        bootstrap_results: Optional[Dict] = None
    ) -&gt; PromotionDecision:
        &quot;&quot;&quot;Make promotion decision based on analysis results.&quot;&quot;&quot;
        
        # Gate checks
        improvement_gate = system_analysis.meets_target_improvement
        significance_gate = system_analysis.meets_significance_threshold
        quality_gate = system_analysis.data_completeness &gt;= 90.0
        
        # CI bounds from bootstrap if available
        ci_lower_bound = 0.0
        if bootstrap_results:
            # Extract CI from bootstrap results
            for result in bootstrap_results.get(&#x27;results&#x27;, []):
                if result[&#x27;experimental_system&#x27;] == system_analysis.system:
                    ci_lower_bound = result[&#x27;ci_lower&#x27;]
                    break
                    
        # Decision logic
        blockers = []
        supporters = []
        
        if not improvement_gate:
            blockers.append(f&quot;Improvement {system_analysis.overall_improvement_pct:.2f}% &lt; target {self.target_improvement}%&quot;)
        else:
            supporters.append(f&quot;Improvement {system_analysis.overall_improvement_pct:.2f}% meets target&quot;)
            
        if not quality_gate:
            blockers.append(f&quot;Data completeness {system_analysis.data_completeness:.1f}% &lt; 90%&quot;)
        else:
            supporters.append(f&quot;Data quality sufficient ({system_analysis.data_completeness:.1f}%)&quot;)
            
        if ci_lower_bound &lt;= 0 and bootstrap_results:
            blockers.append(&quot;Confidence interval lower bound ≤ 0&quot;)
        elif bootstrap_results:
            supporters.append(f&quot;Confidence interval excludes zero (lower bound: {ci_lower_bound:.4f})&quot;)
            
        # Decision  
        if blockers:
            decision = &quot;REJECT&quot;
            confidence = 85.0
        elif len(supporters) &gt;= 2:
            decision = &quot;PROMOTE&quot; 
            confidence = 95.0
        else:
            decision = &quot;DEFER&quot;
            confidence = 60.0
            
        # Recommendations
        next_actions = []
        if not improvement_gate:
            next_actions.append(&quot;Investigate improvement opportunities in quota allocation&quot;)
            
        if not quality_gate:
            next_actions.append(&quot;Collect additional evaluation data to improve completeness&quot;)
            
        if decision == &quot;PROMOTE&quot;:
            next_actions.append(&quot;Proceed with deployment to production&quot;)
        elif decision == &quot;DEFER&quot;:
            next_actions.append(&quot;Collect more data and re-evaluate&quot;)
            
        return PromotionDecision(
            decision=decision,
            confidence=confidence,
            quality_gate_pass=quality_gate,
            significance_gate_pass=significance_gate,
            improvement_gate_pass=improvement_gate,
            min_improvement_achieved=system_analysis.overall_improvement_pct,
            ci_lower_bound=ci_lower_bound,
            effect_size=system_analysis.overall_effect_size,
            promotion_blockers=blockers,
            promotion_supporters=supporters,
            next_actions=next_actions
        )
        
    def analyze_all_systems(self, consolidated_data: Dict) -&gt; Dict[str, SystemAnalysis]:
        &quot;&quot;&quot;Analyze all systems in consolidated data.&quot;&quot;&quot;
        results = consolidated_data[&#x27;results&#x27;]
        systems = sorted(set(r[&#x27;system&#x27;] for r in results))
        
        analyses = {}
        baseline_analysis = None
        
        # Analyze each system
        for system in systems:
            analysis = self.analyze_system(results, system)
            analyses[system] = analysis
            
            if system == &#x27;baseline&#x27;:
                baseline_analysis = analysis
                
        # Comparative analysis against baseline
        if baseline_analysis:
            for system, analysis in analyses.items():
                if system != &#x27;baseline&#x27;:
                    analyses[system] = self.compare_systems(baseline_analysis, analysis)
                    
        return analyses


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description=&quot;Statistical analysis of FastPath evaluation results&quot;,
        formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter,
        epilog=&quot;&quot;&quot;
Examples:
  # Analyze consolidated results
  python score.py --in artifacts/collected.json --out artifacts/analysis.json
  
  # Include bootstrap CI results
  python score.py --in artifacts/collected.json --bootstrap artifacts/ci.json --out artifacts/analysis.json
        &quot;&quot;&quot;
    )
    
    parser.add_argument(&#x27;--in&#x27;, dest=&#x27;input_file&#x27;, type=str, required=True,
                        help=&#x27;Input consolidated results JSON file&#x27;)
    parser.add_argument(&#x27;--bootstrap&#x27;, type=str,
                        help=&#x27;Bootstrap CI results JSON file&#x27;)
    parser.add_argument(&#x27;--out&#x27;, type=str, required=True,
                        help=&#x27;Output analysis JSON file&#x27;)
    parser.add_argument(&#x27;--target-improvement&#x27;, type=float, default=13.0,
                        help=&#x27;Target improvement percentage&#x27;)
    parser.add_argument(&#x27;--promotion-decision&#x27;, action=&#x27;store_true&#x27;,
                        help=&#x27;Include promotion decision analysis&#x27;)
    
    args = parser.parse_args()
    
    # Create analyzer
    analyzer = StatisticalAnalyzer()
    analyzer.target_improvement = args.target_improvement
    
    # Load data
    consolidated_data = analyzer.load_consolidated_results(Path(args.input_file))
    
    # Load bootstrap results if provided
    bootstrap_results = None
    if args.bootstrap:
        with open(args.bootstrap, &#x27;r&#x27;) as f:
            bootstrap_results = json.load(f)
            
    # Analyze all systems
    analyses = analyzer.analyze_all_systems(consolidated_data)
    
    # Make promotion decisions
    promotion_decisions = {}
    if args.promotion_decision:
        for system, analysis in analyses.items():
            if system != &#x27;baseline&#x27;:
                decision = analyzer.make_promotion_decision(analysis, bootstrap_results)
                promotion_decisions[system] = decision
                
    # Save results
    output_data = {
        &#x27;analysis_parameters&#x27;: {
            &#x27;target_improvement_pct&#x27;: args.target_improvement,
            &#x27;significance_threshold&#x27;: analyzer.significance_threshold,
            &#x27;minimum_effect_size&#x27;: analyzer.minimum_effect_size
        },
        &#x27;system_analyses&#x27;: {system: asdict(analysis) for system, analysis in analyses.items()},
        &#x27;promotion_decisions&#x27;: {system: asdict(decision) for system, decision in promotion_decisions.items()},
        &#x27;summary&#x27;: {
            &#x27;total_systems_analyzed&#x27;: len(analyses),
            &#x27;systems_meeting_target&#x27;: sum(1 for a in analyses.values() if a.meets_target_improvement),
            &#x27;recommended_promotions&#x27;: sum(1 for d in promotion_decisions.values() if d.decision == &#x27;PROMOTE&#x27;)
        }
    }
    
    output_path = Path(args.out)
    output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    
    with open(output_path, &#x27;w&#x27;) as f:
        json.dump(output_data, f, indent=2)
        
    logger.info(f&quot;Analysis results saved to {output_path}&quot;)
    
    # Print summary
    print(f&quot;\nStatistical Analysis Summary:&quot;)
    print(f&quot;Target improvement: ≥{args.target_improvement}%&quot;)
    print(f&quot;Systems analyzed: {len(analyses)}&quot;)
    print()

        if system == &#x27;baseline&#x27;:

        else:
            print(f&quot;{system}: {analysis.overall_qa_per_100k:.1f} QA/100k tokens ({analysis.overall_improvement_pct:+.2f}%)&quot;)
            if system in promotion_decisions:
                decision = promotion_decisions[system]
                print(f&quot;  Decision: {decision.decision} (confidence: {decision.confidence:.0f}%)&quot;)
                
    print()
    
    # Print promotion recommendations

#!/usr/bin/env python3
&quot;&quot;&quot;
Benchmark execution wrapper and flag management system for PackRepo FastPath V2.
Handles systematic execution of benchmark variants with proper flag isolation.
&quot;&quot;&quot;

import json
import logging
import os
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from dataclasses import dataclass, asdict
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Dict, List, Optional, Tuple, Any, Union
import statistics
import threading
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor, as_completed
import tempfile
import shutil

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

@dataclass
class BenchmarkConfiguration:
    &quot;&quot;&quot;Configuration for a benchmark run.&quot;&quot;&quot;
    variant: str
    flags: Dict[str, str]
    budgets: List[str]
    seed: int
    iterations: int = 3
    timeout: int = 1800  # 30 minutes
    
@dataclass
class BenchmarkResult:
    &quot;&quot;&quot;Result of a benchmark execution.&quot;&quot;&quot;
    variant: str
    configuration: BenchmarkConfiguration
    success: bool
    duration: float
    metrics: Dict[str, float]
    raw_output: str
    error_output: str
    artifacts: Dict[str, Any]

class BenchmarkRunner:
    &quot;&quot;&quot;Manages systematic execution of FastPath V2 benchmarks.&quot;&quot;&quot;
    
    def __init__(self, project_root: str = &quot;.&quot;, artifacts_dir: str = &quot;artifacts&quot;):
        self.project_root = Path(project_root).resolve()
        self.artifacts_dir = Path(artifacts_dir).resolve()
        self.artifacts_dir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        
        # Ensure benchmark script exists
        self.benchmark_script = self.project_root / &quot;run_fastpath_benchmarks.py&quot;
        if not self.benchmark_script.exists():
            raise FileNotFoundError(f&quot;Benchmark script not found: {self.benchmark_script}&quot;)
        
        # Flag combinations for V1-V5 variants
        self.flag_configurations = {
            &quot;baseline&quot;: BenchmarkConfiguration(
                variant=&quot;baseline&quot;,
                flags={&quot;FASTPATH_POLICY_V2&quot;: &quot;0&quot;},
                budgets=[&quot;50k&quot;, &quot;120k&quot;, &quot;200k&quot;],
                seed=1337
            ),
            &quot;V1&quot;: BenchmarkConfiguration(
                variant=&quot;V1&quot;,
                flags={
                    &quot;FASTPATH_POLICY_V2&quot;: &quot;1&quot;,
                    &quot;FASTPATH_VARIANT&quot;: &quot;V1&quot;,
                    &quot;FASTPATH_AGGRESSIVE_CACHING&quot;: &quot;1&quot;
                },
                budgets=[&quot;50k&quot;, &quot;120k&quot;, &quot;200k&quot;],
                seed=1337
            ),
            &quot;V2&quot;: BenchmarkConfiguration(
                variant=&quot;V2&quot;, 
                flags={
                    &quot;FASTPATH_POLICY_V2&quot;: &quot;1&quot;,
                    &quot;FASTPATH_VARIANT&quot;: &quot;V2&quot;,
                    &quot;FASTPATH_PARALLEL_PROCESSING&quot;: &quot;1&quot;,
                    &quot;FASTPATH_BATCH_SIZE&quot;: &quot;64&quot;
                },
                budgets=[&quot;50k&quot;, &quot;120k&quot;, &quot;200k&quot;],
                seed=1337
            ),
            &quot;V3&quot;: BenchmarkConfiguration(
                variant=&quot;V3&quot;,
                flags={
                    &quot;FASTPATH_POLICY_V2&quot;: &quot;1&quot;, 
                    &quot;FASTPATH_VARIANT&quot;: &quot;V3&quot;,
                    &quot;FASTPATH_MEMORY_OPTIMIZATION&quot;: &quot;1&quot;,
                    &quot;FASTPATH_COMPRESSION&quot;: &quot;1&quot;
                },
                budgets=[&quot;50k&quot;, &quot;120k&quot;, &quot;200k&quot;],
                seed=1337
            ),
            &quot;V4&quot;: BenchmarkConfiguration(
                variant=&quot;V4&quot;,
                flags={
                    &quot;FASTPATH_POLICY_V2&quot;: &quot;1&quot;,
                    &quot;FASTPATH_VARIANT&quot;: &quot;V4&quot;, 
                    &quot;FASTPATH_HYBRID_MODE&quot;: &quot;1&quot;,
                    &quot;FASTPATH_ADAPTIVE_THRESHOLD&quot;: &quot;0.85&quot;
                },
                budgets=[&quot;50k&quot;, &quot;120k&quot;, &quot;200k&quot;],
                seed=1337
            ),
            &quot;V5&quot;: BenchmarkConfiguration(
                variant=&quot;V5&quot;,
                flags={
                    &quot;FASTPATH_POLICY_V2&quot;: &quot;1&quot;,
                    &quot;FASTPATH_VARIANT&quot;: &quot;V5&quot;,
                    &quot;FASTPATH_AGGRESSIVE_CACHING&quot;: &quot;1&quot;,
                    &quot;FASTPATH_PARALLEL_PROCESSING&quot;: &quot;1&quot;, 
                    &quot;FASTPATH_MEMORY_OPTIMIZATION&quot;: &quot;1&quot;,
                    &quot;FASTPATH_ADAPTIVE_THRESHOLD&quot;: &quot;0.90&quot;
                },
                budgets=[&quot;50k&quot;, &quot;120k&quot;, &quot;200k&quot;],
                seed=1337
            )
        }
    
    def run_single_benchmark(self, config: BenchmarkConfiguration) -&gt; BenchmarkResult:
        &quot;&quot;&quot;Execute a single benchmark configuration.&quot;&quot;&quot;
        logger.info(f&quot;Running benchmark for variant: {config.variant}&quot;)
        
        start_time = time.time()
        result = BenchmarkResult(
            variant=config.variant,
            configuration=config,
            success=False,
            duration=0,
            metrics={},
            raw_output=&quot;&quot;,
            error_output=&quot;&quot;,
            artifacts={}
        )
        
        try:
            # Create isolated output file
            output_file = self.artifacts_dir / f&quot;{config.variant.lower()}_benchmark.json&quot;
            
            # Build command
            budgets_str = &quot;,&quot;.join(config.budgets)
            cmd = [
                sys.executable,
                str(self.benchmark_script),
                &quot;--budgets&quot;, budgets_str,
                &quot;--seed&quot;, str(config.seed),
                &quot;--output&quot;, str(output_file)
            ]
            
            # Set up environment with flags
            env = os.environ.copy()
            env.update(config.flags)
            
            # Log the configuration
            logger.info(f&quot;Command: {&#x27; &#x27;.join(cmd)}&quot;)
            logger.info(f&quot;Environment flags: {config.flags}&quot;)
            
            # Execute benchmark
            process = subprocess.run(
                cmd,
                cwd=self.project_root,
                env=env,
                capture_output=True,
                text=True,
                timeout=config.timeout
            )
            
            result.duration = time.time() - start_time
            result.raw_output = process.stdout
            result.error_output = process.stderr
            
            if process.returncode == 0:
                result.success = True
                logger.info(f&quot;Benchmark {config.variant} completed successfully in {result.duration:.2f}s&quot;)
                
                # Load results if output file exists
                if output_file.exists():
                    with open(output_file) as f:
                        benchmark_data = json.load(f)
                    
                    result.artifacts[&quot;raw_data&quot;] = benchmark_data
                    result.metrics = self._extract_metrics(benchmark_data, config.variant)
                else:
                    logger.warning(f&quot;Output file not created: {output_file}&quot;)
                    
            else:
                logger.error(f&quot;Benchmark {config.variant} failed with exit code {process.returncode}&quot;)
                logger.error(f&quot;STDERR: {process.stderr}&quot;)
                
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            result.duration = time.time() - start_time
            result.error_output = f&quot;Benchmark timed out after {config.timeout} seconds&quot;
            logger.error(f&quot;Benchmark {config.variant} timed out&quot;)
            
        except Exception as e:
            result.duration = time.time() - start_time
            result.error_output = str(e)
            logger.error(f&quot;Benchmark {config.variant} failed with exception: {e}&quot;)
        
        # Save individual result
        result_file = self.artifacts_dir / f&quot;{config.variant.lower()}_result.json&quot;
        with open(result_file, &quot;w&quot;) as f:
            json.dump(asdict(result), f, indent=2, default=str)
        
        return result
    
    def _extract_metrics(self, benchmark_data: Dict[str, Any], variant: str) -&gt; Dict[str, float]:
        &quot;&quot;&quot;Extract key metrics from benchmark data.&quot;&quot;&quot;
        metrics = {}
        
        try:
            # Standard metrics expected from run_fastpath_benchmarks.py
            if &quot;qa_per_100k&quot; in benchmark_data:
                metrics[&quot;qa_100k&quot;] = float(benchmark_data[&quot;qa_per_100k&quot;])
            
            if &quot;latency_p95&quot; in benchmark_data:
                metrics[&quot;latency_p95&quot;] = float(benchmark_data[&quot;latency_p95&quot;])
            
            if &quot;latency_mean&quot; in benchmark_data:
                metrics[&quot;latency_mean&quot;] = float(benchmark_data[&quot;latency_mean&quot;])
            
            if &quot;memory_peak_mb&quot; in benchmark_data:
                metrics[&quot;memory_peak&quot;] = float(benchmark_data[&quot;memory_peak_mb&quot;])
            
            if &quot;throughput_ops_per_sec&quot; in benchmark_data:
                metrics[&quot;throughput&quot;] = float(benchmark_data[&quot;throughput_ops_per_sec&quot;])
            
            # Compute efficiency metrics
            if &quot;total_requests&quot; in benchmark_data and &quot;total_duration&quot; in benchmark_data:
                metrics[&quot;requests_per_second&quot;] = benchmark_data[&quot;total_requests&quot;] / benchmark_data[&quot;total_duration&quot;]
            
            # Budget-specific metrics
            for budget in [&quot;50k&quot;, &quot;120k&quot;, &quot;200k&quot;]:
                budget_key = f&quot;budget_{budget}&quot;
                if budget_key in benchmark_data:
                    metrics[f&quot;qa_100k_{budget}&quot;] = benchmark_data[budget_key].get(&quot;qa_per_100k&quot;, 0)
                    metrics[f&quot;latency_{budget}&quot;] = benchmark_data[budget_key].get(&quot;latency_p95&quot;, 0)
            
            logger.info(f&quot;Extracted {len(metrics)} metrics for {variant}&quot;)
            
        except Exception as e:
            logger.warning(f&quot;Failed to extract metrics for {variant}: {e}&quot;)
        
        return metrics
    
    def run_parallel_benchmarks(self, variants: Optional[List[str]] = None, 
                               max_workers: int = 3) -&gt; Dict[str, BenchmarkResult]:
        &quot;&quot;&quot;Run multiple benchmark variants in parallel.&quot;&quot;&quot;
        if variants is None:
            variants = list(self.flag_configurations.keys())
        
        logger.info(f&quot;Running benchmarks for variants: {variants}&quot;)
        results = {}
        
        with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=max_workers) as executor:
            # Submit all benchmark jobs
            future_to_variant = {}
            for variant in variants:
                if variant in self.flag_configurations:
                    config = self.flag_configurations[variant]
                    future = executor.submit(self.run_single_benchmark, config)
                    future_to_variant[future] = variant
                else:
                    logger.error(f&quot;Unknown variant: {variant}&quot;)
            
            # Collect results as they complete
            for future in as_completed(future_to_variant):
                variant = future_to_variant[future]
                try:
                    result = future.result()
                    results[variant] = result
                    
                    status = &quot;✅&quot; if result.success else &quot;❌&quot;
                    logger.info(f&quot;{status} {variant}: {result.duration:.1f}s&quot;)
                    
                except Exception as e:
                    logger.error(f&quot;Failed to get result for {variant}: {e}&quot;)
                    # Create a failed result
                    results[variant] = BenchmarkResult(
                        variant=variant,
                        configuration=self.flag_configurations[variant],
                        success=False,
                        duration=0,
                        metrics={},
                        raw_output=&quot;&quot;,
                        error_output=str(e),
                        artifacts={}
                    )
        
        return results
    
    def run_sequential_benchmarks(self, variants: Optional[List[str]] = None) -&gt; Dict[str, BenchmarkResult]:
        &quot;&quot;&quot;Run benchmark variants sequentially (more stable but slower).&quot;&quot;&quot;
        if variants is None:
            variants = list(self.flag_configurations.keys())
        
        logger.info(f&quot;Running benchmarks sequentially for variants: {variants}&quot;)
        results = {}
        
        for variant in variants:
            if variant in self.flag_configurations:
                config = self.flag_configurations[variant]
                result = self.run_single_benchmark(config)
                results[variant] = result
                
                status = &quot;✅&quot; if result.success else &quot;❌&quot;
                logger.info(f&quot;{status} {variant}: {result.duration:.1f}s&quot;)
            else:
                logger.error(f&quot;Unknown variant: {variant}&quot;)
        
        return results
    
    def generate_comparison_report(self, results: Dict[str, BenchmarkResult]) -&gt; Dict[str, Any]:
        &quot;&quot;&quot;Generate a comprehensive comparison report.&quot;&quot;&quot;
        logger.info(&quot;Generating benchmark comparison report&quot;)
        
        # Get baseline metrics
        baseline_metrics = results.get(&quot;baseline&quot;, BenchmarkResult(&quot;baseline&quot;, None, False, 0, {}, &quot;&quot;, &quot;&quot;, {})).metrics
        baseline_qa = baseline_metrics.get(&quot;qa_100k&quot;, 0.7230)  # Default baseline
        baseline_latency = baseline_metrics.get(&quot;latency_p95&quot;, 896)  # Default baseline
        
        report = {
            &quot;timestamp&quot;: time.time(),
            &quot;baseline&quot;: {
                &quot;qa_100k&quot;: baseline_qa,
                &quot;latency_p95&quot;: baseline_latency
            },
            &quot;variants&quot;: {},
            &quot;comparisons&quot;: {},
            &quot;summary&quot;: {
                &quot;total_variants&quot;: len([r for r in results.values() if r.success]),
                &quot;successful_runs&quot;: len([r for r in results.values() if r.success]),
                &quot;failed_runs&quot;: len([r for r in results.values() if not r.success])
            },
            &quot;recommendations&quot;: []
        }
        
        # Process each variant
        best_qa_improvement = 0
        best_variant = None
        
        for variant, result in results.items():
            if not result.success or variant == &quot;baseline&quot;:
                continue
            
            variant_qa = result.metrics.get(&quot;qa_100k&quot;, 0)
            variant_latency = result.metrics.get(&quot;latency_p95&quot;, 0)
            
            if variant_qa == 0:
                continue
            
            # Calculate improvements/regressions
            qa_improvement = (variant_qa - baseline_qa) / baseline_qa
            latency_regression = (variant_latency - baseline_latency) / baseline_latency if baseline_latency &gt; 0 else 0
            
            # Track best variant
            if qa_improvement &gt; best_qa_improvement:
                best_qa_improvement = qa_improvement
                best_variant = variant
            
            variant_data = {
                &quot;metrics&quot;: result.metrics,
                &quot;qa_improvement&quot;: qa_improvement,
                &quot;latency_regression&quot;: latency_regression,
                &quot;duration&quot;: result.duration,
                &quot;success&quot;: result.success
            }
            
            report[&quot;variants&quot;][variant] = variant_data
            
            # Compare against thresholds
            report[&quot;comparisons&quot;][variant] = {
                &quot;meets_qa_threshold&quot;: qa_improvement &gt;= 0.13,  # +13% required
                &quot;meets_latency_threshold&quot;: latency_regression &lt;= 0.10,  # ≤10% regression
                &quot;overall_acceptable&quot;: qa_improvement &gt;= 0.13 and latency_regression &lt;= 0.10
            }
        
        # Generate recommendations
        acceptable_variants = [
            v for v, comp in report[&quot;comparisons&quot;].items() 
            if comp[&quot;overall_acceptable&quot;]
        ]
        
        if acceptable_variants:
            report[&quot;recommendations&quot;].append(f&quot;✅ Variants meeting acceptance criteria: {&#x27;, &#x27;.join(acceptable_variants)}&quot;)
        else:
            report[&quot;recommendations&quot;].append(&quot;❌ No variants meet both QA (+13%) and latency (≤10%) criteria&quot;)
        
        if best_variant:
            report[&quot;recommendations&quot;].append(f&quot;🏆 Best QA improvement: {best_variant} (+{best_qa_improvement:.1%})&quot;)
        
        # Save report
        report_file = self.artifacts_dir / &quot;benchmark_comparison.json&quot;
        with open(report_file, &quot;w&quot;) as f:
            json.dump(report, f, indent=2)
        
        logger.info(f&quot;Comparison report saved to {report_file}&quot;)
        return report
    
    def run_complete_benchmark_suite(self, parallel: bool = True) -&gt; Dict[str, Any]:
        &quot;&quot;&quot;Run the complete benchmark suite and generate report.&quot;&quot;&quot;
        logger.info(&quot;🚀 Starting complete FastPath V2 benchmark suite&quot;)
        suite_start = time.time()
        
        # Run benchmarks
        if parallel:
            results = self.run_parallel_benchmarks()
        else:
            results = self.run_sequential_benchmarks()
        
        # Generate comparison report
        comparison_report = self.generate_comparison_report(results)
        
        # Create summary
        suite_duration = time.time() - suite_start
        summary = {
            &quot;suite_duration&quot;: suite_duration,
            &quot;results&quot;: {variant: asdict(result) for variant, result in results.items()},
            &quot;comparison&quot;: comparison_report,
            &quot;execution_summary&quot;: {
                &quot;total_time_minutes&quot;: suite_duration / 60,
                &quot;variants_executed&quot;: len(results),
                &quot;successful_variants&quot;: len([r for r in results.values() if r.success]),
                &quot;parallel_execution&quot;: parallel
            }
        }
        
        # Save complete summary
        summary_file = self.artifacts_dir / &quot;benchmark_suite_summary.json&quot;
        with open(summary_file, &quot;w&quot;) as f:
            json.dump(summary, f, indent=2, default=str)
        
        logger.info(f&quot;🎯 Benchmark suite completed in {suite_duration/60:.1f} minutes&quot;)
        logger.info(f&quot;📊 Results saved to {summary_file}&quot;)
        
        return summary

def main():
    &quot;&quot;&quot;Main entry point for benchmark runner.&quot;&quot;&quot;
    import argparse
    
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=&quot;PackRepo FastPath V2 Benchmark Runner&quot;)
    parser.add_argument(&quot;--variants&quot;, nargs=&quot;+&quot;, 
                       choices=[&quot;baseline&quot;, &quot;V1&quot;, &quot;V2&quot;, &quot;V3&quot;, &quot;V4&quot;, &quot;V5&quot;],
                       help=&quot;Variants to run (default: all)&quot;)
    parser.add_argument(&quot;--parallel&quot;, action=&quot;store_true&quot;, default=True,
                       help=&quot;Run benchmarks in parallel&quot;)
    parser.add_argument(&quot;--sequential&quot;, action=&quot;store_true&quot;,
                       help=&quot;Run benchmarks sequentially&quot;)
    parser.add_argument(&quot;--max-workers&quot;, type=int, default=3,
                       help=&quot;Maximum parallel workers&quot;)
    parser.add_argument(&quot;--project-root&quot;, default=&quot;.&quot;, 
                       help=&quot;Project root directory&quot;)
    parser.add_argument(&quot;--artifacts-dir&quot;, default=&quot;artifacts&quot;,
                       help=&quot;Artifacts output directory&quot;)
    parser.add_argument(&quot;--verbose&quot;, &quot;-v&quot;, action=&quot;store_true&quot;,
                       help=&quot;Verbose logging&quot;)
    
    args = parser.parse_args()
    
    # Configure logging
    log_level = logging.DEBUG if args.verbose else logging.INFO
    logging.basicConfig(
        level=log_level,
        format=&#x27;%(asctime)s - %(name)s - %(levelname)s - %(message)s&#x27;
    )
    
    # Override parallel setting if sequential requested
    parallel = not args.sequential and args.parallel
    
    try:
        # Create runner
        runner = BenchmarkRunner(
            project_root=args.project_root,
            artifacts_dir=args.artifacts_dir
        )
        
        # Run benchmark suite
        summary = runner.run_complete_benchmark_suite(parallel=parallel)
        
        # Print summary
        print(&quot;\n&quot; + &quot;=&quot;*60)
        print(&quot;📊 FASTPATH V2 BENCHMARK SUITE RESULTS&quot;)
        print(&quot;=&quot;*60)
        print(f&quot;⏱️  Total Duration: {summary[&#x27;execution_summary&#x27;][&#x27;total_time_minutes&#x27;]:.1f} minutes&quot;)
        print(f&quot;🔄 Variants Executed: {summary[&#x27;execution_summary&#x27;][&#x27;variants_executed&#x27;]}&quot;)
        print(f&quot;✅ Successful Runs: {summary[&#x27;execution_summary&#x27;][&#x27;successful_variants&#x27;]}&quot;)
        print(f&quot;🔀 Execution Mode: {&#x27;Parallel&#x27; if parallel else &#x27;Sequential&#x27;}&quot;)
        
        if summary[&quot;comparison&quot;][&quot;recommendations&quot;]:
            print(&quot;\n📋 Recommendations:&quot;)
            for rec in summary[&quot;comparison&quot;][&quot;recommendations&quot;]:
                print(f&quot;   {rec}&quot;)
        
        print(f&quot;\n📁 Detailed results: {args.artifacts_dir}/benchmark_suite_summary.json&quot;)
        
        # Exit code based on success
        success_count = summary[&quot;execution_summary&quot;][&quot;successful_variants&quot;]
        total_count = summary[&quot;execution_summary&quot;][&quot;variants_executed&quot;]
        
        if success_count == total_count and success_count &gt; 0:
            sys.exit(0)
        else:
            sys.exit(1)
            
    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f&quot;Benchmark suite failed: {e}&quot;)
        sys.exit(1)

if __name__ == &quot;__main__&quot;:
    main()
